messages.author: 839eb4092a42aa65
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Use gurobi with Shinyapps.io ?
parts:
Gurobi is an R package distributed with the commercial Gurobi software package.

Unless shinyapps.io has licensing to use Gurobi--which I doubt--then you won't be able to do this.

Your options are:

a) use shinyapps.io with a free solver, eg. lpsolve using the lpSolveAPI package. But this will take longer to solve things than Gurobi. 

b) host apps on your own server with Gurobi configured. But I am not sure what the licensing is like for Gurobi and if this is allowed.

c) a combination of the two. Host your app on shinyapps.io have it send problems to your server for processing, and then send the results back to shinyapps.io. Again, similar concerns with licensing apply.

Cheers,

Jeff
